sentences.en: The plane is on the way from Tokyo to Italy.
sentences.zh: 从东京飞往意大利的飞机正在途中。

sentences.en: Julie received a Christmas card from her brother in Italy.
sentences.zh: 朱莉收到了她住在意大利的哥哥寄来的圣诞卡。

sentences.en: In Italy, each village holds a festival once a year.
sentences.zh: 在意大利，每个村庄每年都会举办一次节日。
